how to make people low key
obsess over your vibe

1. a real smile

one that reaches your eyes.

2. open posture

arms uncrossed, shoulders back.

3. warm eye contact

about 60% of the time.

4. listen properly

no interrupting, phone away.

5. use their name

once or twice, softly.

7. casual depth

always have something interesting
to share. i read one story a day.
